title: Uniform bins — bell-shaped distribution
description: The canonical Histogram configuration: equal-width bins covering a numeric range with a bell-shaped count distribution.

sections.title: Context — what the Histogram widget renders

data.markdown:
## Histogram contract

The widget takes:

- `binEdges` — strictly increasing array of $k + 1$ edge values.
- `counts` — array of $k$ non-negative integers (one per bin).

It renders a bar chart where each bar's width spans `[binEdges[i], binEdges[i+1]]` and its height is `counts[i]`. The schema enforces `binEdges.length === counts.length + 1` — mismatched arrays are rejected at lesson load.
